description: This file defines a Java interface 'DData' that specifies methods for obtaining data readers and writers, as well as creating subscription objects in a pub-sub framework within the 'org.eclipse.ditto' package.

classes.name: DData
classes.description: Java interface for distributed data read/write operations and subscription creation in a pub-sub system.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns the distributed data reader for type R.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns the distributed data writer for type W.

methods.name: createSubscriptions
methods.description: Creates and returns a new, empty subscriptions object for type W.
